notes: Forward run_frames: fourth-order CFS-PML, 10 m spacing, 1 ms step; fixed seed. Timings include reference rendering or Metal startup, file transport and every-frame rendering. Relative difference is the maximum of per-output max absolute errors normalized by each reference peak. Child ru_maxrss is a cumulative high-water mark, so its delta is not a reliable per-call peak and may omit GPU allocations. CPU tracemalloc excludes native allocations. Runtime targets are estimates.
